caption: The drawing depicts a hexagonal or octagonal lidded box, positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The box itself is rendered with a high level of detail, showing horizontal banding that suggests it is made of a layered stone, such as onyx or agate, with colors ranging from gray, beige, and brown to hints of reddish-orange. The lid fits snugly on the box and has a small, red knob in the center. The overall form has beveled edges and angular facets, and the colors are muted but naturalistic, accentuating the layered texture of the stone. There is a faint area of yellowish shading around the object, suggesting shadow or highlighting the space immediately surrounding the box. The surface of the box and lid appears smooth, with some reflective qualities indicated by the use of lighter tones. The rest of the paper is left blank, drawing focus to the object. There is a signature or inscription in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Jewel Casket
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
